wording.recommended_literature_paragraph: We give a self-contained construction for the spatially restricted Hamiltonian in OWR 7/2025. Siebert's earlier high-density cluster and phase argument establishes norm discontinuity for full-space difference potentials. Its proof adapts directly to the bounded symmetric cutoff kernel, yielding the existential discontinuity conclusion. The calculation here specifies one annihilation mode and Slater states for which the norm differences tend to 2, using a quantitative free-leakage comparison. We make no priority claim for this localization sharpening.
